items.description:
This Centurion branch of Adendorff Machinery Mart, in Rooihuiskraal North, forms part of a tools and equipment retail chain that has traded since 1990 and operates around 30 stores across South Africa. The store stocks a broad range of equipment organised into categories such as air compressors, air tools, construction and engineering equipment and accessories, generators, hand and power tools, pumps, tool storage, welding equipment, woodworking machinery, meat-processing equipment, and garage, gardening and household items.

Customers shopping at this branch can apply for Adendorff's trade credit facility to support ongoing purchases, and larger orders can be arranged through the chain's bulk-order quote service. Adendorff also publishes trade-specific and seasonal catalogues covering its tools and machinery ranges, and the chain offers nationwide delivery to customers who are unable to visit a branch in person.

Afro Hair Salon, on Paul Kruger Street in Les Marais, Pretoria, is a hair salon specialising in Afro-textured hair care. Its service menu covers balayage, blow drying, children's haircuts, curly-hair treatments, hair braiding, hair colouring, hair extensions, hair weaves, keratin treatments, locs, perms and permanent hair straightening. The salon caters to a range of hair types and styling needs, from everyday blow-dries and colour work to more involved protective styling such as braiding, weaves and locs.

It is open six days a week, from Monday to Saturday, and closed on Sundays. The combination of chemical, textured and protective hair services positions it as a dedicated specialist in Afro hair care within the Les Marais area of central Pretoria.

AIGS, based in Highveld Techno Park, Centurion, is a technology consultancy built around close partnership with its customers and solution partners. The company's stated focus is on helping its partners unlock maximum value for their own customers, delivering solutions alongside technical support, problem-solving and project-management assistance where required.

Its service lines include OpenEdge and Corticon software solutions, run through an AIGS Consultancy, Training and Services offering, alongside a partner-facing Roundtable programme. AIGS positions data, and the ability to act quickly on it, as central to its approach, aiming to customise each solution to a client's specific requirements through ongoing strategic partnerships with like-minded solution providers. The company emphasises collaborative delivery over simply promoting product features, working alongside partners to support their end customers across the full lifecycle of a technology solution.

AliSom Enterprise Services (AES), based in Doringkloof, Centurion, was established on 1 July 2017 as a business-to-business service provider in the ICT sector. Alongside standard connectivity, AES offers bespoke digital and IoT solutions, differentiating itself from pure connectivity resellers. Its management team has a combined total of more than 70 years in the telecommunications sector.

AES supplies voice, data and data-related products and hardware, including handsets, modems and routers, and provides technical support through accredited Repair Centres staffed by trained and certified data technicians. Its client base spans small, medium and large businesses as well as government departments, municipalities and state-owned entities. Specific offerings include fixed broadband and 5G internet, fibre and wireless connectivity, mobile and fixed voice and data services, VoIP office solutions, IoT asset tracking, energy-saving and machine-to-machine technology, and cloud hosting services including Microsoft Azure.

Allos Connect is a video marketing agency based in Claudius, Pretoria, founded roughly a decade ago on the idea that every brand has a story worth telling. The agency produces video content ranging from corporate videos to brand storytelling, tailoring each production to a client's business objectives. Its event production service covers virtual, hybrid and in-person corporate events, handling everything from live streaming during an event to post-event video content. A further brand-building arm provides digital marketing support, planning and executing campaigns as an outsourced marketing department for clients who want ongoing promotional support rather than one-off projects.

Allos Connect works with businesses ranging from large corporates to smaller, ambitious enterprises, aiming to capture the essence of each client's business and communicate it clearly to its audience through video.

Alu Fox is a manufacturer and installer of aluminium and glass products, operating from a factory in Derdepoort, Pretoria, and serving clients nationwide. The company was established in 2020, and its team brings more than 30 years of combined experience in aluminium and glass work.

Its product range includes custom windows and doors in stacking, sliding, folding, hinged, standard and frameless configurations, along with top-hung and slide-hung variants built to order. Alu Fox also supplies glass and mirror products made to building-regulation requirements, skylights and glass roofing designed to bring natural light into interiors, frameless showers manufactured to each customer's specifications, balustrades, and automated door systems. The business reports having completed more than 250 projects and over 500 installations across residential and commercial settings, covering everything from window and door fittings to full glass-roofing and shower installations.

items.description:
Ancil Research Laboratories, based in Alphen Park, Pretoria, is a technology company that designs and develops a wide range of specialised electronic systems. Its product and project lines include radio-frequency identification asset-tracking systems, GSM payphones, train-integrity monitoring, ISM radio modems, telephone voice recorders, remote meter-reading equipment, and PCM/G3 transceivers for rural telecommunication systems.

The company has also developed a mobile surveillance system known as WildFinder, a prison cellphone detector, a group decision-support system called TradeOff, an aviation antenna and SpeedPanel display, an animal-tranquilliser dart tracking system, a hand-held Yagi antenna, and load-switch equipment. Further projects cover baby and prisoner tagging devices, general asset tracking, sinewave UPS units, notification devices, a pseudo-Doppler direction finder and a motion detector, presented on the company's website as current products and projects developed through its own engineering and research work.

Apache Manufacturing CC is a company in the Rosslyn Industrial Area of Akasia, Pretoria, working in electrical goods and air conditioning. It is listed under electrical machinery and equipment manufacturing, with a focus on other electrical equipment, and its activities are described as covering air conditioning repairs, services and equipment alongside electrical machinery more broadly.

The company operates within the Rosslyn Improvement District, an industrial area north of Pretoria that is home to a number of manufacturing and electrical-equipment businesses. Apache Manufacturing's listing associates it with air-conditioning equipment and electrical machinery servicing, positioning it as a supplier and service provider for air-conditioning and related electrical systems to businesses operating in and around the Rosslyn industrial node.

ASG Software Solutions, based in Ashlea Gardens, Pretoria, combines business consulting with custom software development to help decision-makers improve the performance of their organisations. The company is a Level 2 B-BBEE contributor and describes diversity as central to its approach to innovation.

Its services include business intelligence and management information systems, which extract insights from business processes to support performance-improvement initiatives, either as a module within a larger custom solution or as a stand-alone reporting system built on a client's existing data sources. ASG also designs and develops bespoke software solutions tailored to a business's specific needs and working environment, aiming to ensure that the resulting system supports existing business processes rather than requiring the business to adapt around the software. A separate consulting service complements this software work for clients across its customer base.

items.description:
Avis operates a car rental branch, known as Pretoria Downtown, at 70 Francis Baard Street in Pretoria, as part of the international Avis Rent a Car network. The branch is open Monday to Friday from 07:00 to 18:00, Saturdays from 08:00 to 13:00, and Sundays from 08:00 to 12:00.

Its standard return policy requires rental vehicles to be brought back to the branch during its operating hours; where a location offers an after-hours key-drop box, a customer who leaves a vehicle outside those hours remains responsible for it and for any related charges, including damage or theft, until the contract can be closed on the next business day. Where no drop box is available, the branch does not permit vehicles to be left after closing, and customers must either return the car once the branch reopens or arrange to change the drop-off location to the nearest regional airport, at their own cost.

Bakwena Auto Sales is a pre-owned vehicle dealership at 185 Lynn Road in Karenpark, Akasia, Pretoria North, which describes itself as a family-run business. The dealership buys and sells a range of vehicle types, including cars, motorbikes, quad bikes, boats and trucks, and accepts trade-ins from customers looking to swap their current vehicle. It assists buyers with vehicle finance and operates its own workshop, where customers can have purchased vehicles serviced.

Bakwena Auto Sales describes itself as one of the top-performing independent used-vehicle dealerships in the Pretoria area, attributing its standing to an emphasis on honesty and loyalty toward customers. Its stock has included makes such as Toyota, Lexus, Mercedes-Benz and BMW models spanning different ages, mileages and price points, supported by a sales team that assists customers through the buying process from start to finish.

Baobab in Menlyn, trading from Shop UF53-56 in Menlyn Park Shopping Centre at the corner of Atterbury Road and Lois Avenue, is a cafe and grill themed around the African proverb that likens wisdom to a baobab tree too large for any one person to embrace. The restaurant offers a main menu, a wine list and a set menu, and can be booked for events and celebrations.

It trades Monday to Thursday from 11:30 to 21:30, Friday and Saturday from 11:00 to 22:00, and Sunday from 11:00 to 21:30. Baobab operates a second branch at Wonderboom Junction in Annlin, but the Menlyn restaurant is the one situated within Menlyn Park Shopping Centre itself, serving diners from its shopping-centre location in Pretoria's eastern suburbs.

Bay Tree Guest House, in the quiet, jacaranda-lined suburb of Bailey's Muckleneuk — generally regarded as part of Brooklyn, Pretoria — offers four-star accommodation in seven spacious en suite rooms. The guest house sits on the Gautrain bus route and is close to the South African Bureau of Standards, numerous foreign embassies and consulates, several hospitals, the Pretoria Advocates Chambers, the South African National Accreditation System, the South African Council for the Blind, Optima college, the University of Pretoria and the University of South Africa, as well as the offices of the Auditor-General and the South African Revenue Service. Nearby visitor attractions include Loftus Versfeld Stadium, the Austin Roberts Bird Sanctuary, the Union Buildings, the Voortrekker Monument and Brooklyn Mall.

Guest amenities include free Wi-Fi throughout the property, solar power that keeps the guest house running during loadshedding, air-conditioned en suite rooms, some with self-catering facilities, DSTV, safe off-street parking, a swimming pool and lapa area, gardens planted with cycads, clivias and orchids, and an optional full English breakfast.

BE Prop, also known as Beprop Estate Agents and Property Management, is a real estate agency established in 2007 and based in Laudium, Centurion. The agency focuses on the sale and rental of residential and commercial property, describing itself as entirely focused on providing quality professional service and treating the needs of its clients as paramount. It presents its total commitment to each client as being carried through a blend of high-class marketing and advertising techniques combined with the presentation of stylish property listings.

BE Prop lists properties for sale and for rent, and also tracks properties that have already been sold or let, giving prospective buyers, sellers, tenants and landlords a way to see the agency's current and completed transactions. The agency invites property owners to get in touch if they have a property to sell or rent, and invites buyers and tenants to make contact if they are looking to buy or rent, positioning itself as a full-service residential and commercial agency for clients in and around Centurion.

Gems and Things, in Shop 45 of Monument Park Shopping Centre on Skilpad Road, is a gemstone, bead and jewellery-supplies store that was formerly known as Beads Direct. The business began in Route 21 Corporate Park, where it built a reputation supplying bulk beads to makers, hobbyists and other businesses. In March 2025, Beads Direct was sold and relaunched under the Gems and Things name, broadening its focus from a bulk-bead supplier into a wider jewellery-making destination.

Its current range spans beads, findings and components, jewellery chain, stringing materials, pendants and charms, stainless steel and premium metals, tools and supplies, and general beading and jewellery-making materials, along with specials and bulk-buy options. The store trades Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 and Saturday from 09:00 to 14:00, and is closed on Sundays, welcoming hobbyist and professional customers alike to shop in person.

items.description:
Bester Attorneys Inc is a law firm on Migmatite Drive in Zwartkop, Centurion, offering legal services across several practice areas. Its stated areas of practice include family law, criminal law, commercial law and estate planning, with the firm aiming to give clients clear guidance through each type of matter.

The practice offers flexible consultation hours, allowing clients to arrange appointments around their own schedules rather than a single fixed time slot. The Zwartkop office includes a wheelchair-accessible parking area, making the practice easier to reach for clients with mobility needs. Bester Attorneys Inc positions itself as a Centurion-based firm that clients can approach for guidance on family, criminal and commercial legal matters, as well as planning the transfer of an estate.

Blackbeard Attorneys Inc, based in Wierdapark, Centurion, is a law firm with offices in Pretoria that also maintains a national footprint, providing legal services to clients across South Africa. The firm specialises in corporate law, debt collections, property law, labour law, and litigation in both the High Court and the lower courts, representing clients ranging from individuals to large juristic entities, including public and private companies and trusts.

Its debt-collection department uses both soft methods, such as telephonic demands for payment, and harder methods involving litigation, including Section 65 enquiries in court, to recover outstanding debts on behalf of clients. The firm's labour law department represents both employees and employers, assisting with workplace disputes, wrongful and constructive dismissals, and the processes involved in restructuring and disciplinary hearings. Blackbeard Attorneys Inc also uses information technology systems internally, which it says helps it respond to client matters more quickly and effectively.

items.description:
Boardmans, trading from Menlyn Park Shopping Centre, is a branch of a homeware retail chain that describes itself as South Africa's original homestore, in business since 1982. The chain's head office is based in Sandton, Gauteng, and it trades through branches across the country as well as online.

Boardmans sells a range of home and lifestyle products, including small kitchen appliances, bedding and towels, crockery and cutlery, coffee-related products, and outdoor cooking and entertaining items. The Menlyn store gives shoppers in the eastern suburbs of Pretoria access to this long-established homeware range from within Menlyn Park Shopping Centre, alongside the chain's broader catalogue of bed, bath, kitchen and entertaining products sold nationally.

Boardmart, in Louwlardia, Centurion, is a board distributor whose main focus is on cutting and edging boards to order for its customers. The company stocks a wide variety of melamine boards, veneer boards and gloss boards, along with worktop surfaces, hardboards and related sheet materials. Alongside supplying boards in bulk, Boardmart offers an in-house cutting and edging service, shaping boards to the dimensions customers need rather than selling only full, uncut sheets.

The company offers free delivery anywhere in Gauteng, extending its board-distribution and cutting service to customers across the province rather than limiting collection to its Louwlardia premises. Boardmart positions itself as a quality-focused supplier for customers needing melamine, chipboard-style and hardboard sheet materials for furniture and joinery projects.

items.description:
Bonne Maison is a real estate company based in Riviera, Pretoria, specialising in the sale and rental of residential and commercial property across Pretoria and its surrounding suburbs. The agency describes its mission as providing service with integrity and honesty, acting in the interests of both buyers and sellers in every transaction.

It assists with a wide range of property types, from townhouses and luxury homes to student housing and cottages, covering different budgets and living arrangements. Bonne Maison offers a Property Finder service, under which it actively searches for a property that matches a client's specific requirements, as well as a free evaluation service that gives property owners a market estimate of their home's value before putting it on the market.

Bontshi, in Hennopspark, Centurion, is a printing company that was started in 2001 and has grown to operate across seven internal departments. The business describes its core values as creativity, communication, honesty and teamwork, aiming to treat every client's project as an individual exercise in meeting that client's specific requirements to the highest standard. Its team says it stays in contact with clients throughout a project and remains available after a job is completed, and that it takes on only the work it is confident of delivering at the highest level, prioritising honesty, timeliness and quality.

Bontshi's offerings span its printing portfolio, graphic design work, signage and branding, and corporate gifts and uniforms, and the company holds a BEE Level 4 certification. It describes its team as a small, dynamic and agile group of professionals who continue to look for new printing-related business.

Broadway Laundry, based in Valhalla, Centurion, operates across three divisions covering laundry, linen and equipment. Its laundry and dry-cleaning division offers dry cleaning, collection and delivery, and commercial laundry processing for business clients. The linen division, described as Premium Linen Solutions, supplies hotel linen, hospital linen and guesthouse linen, along with custom linen manufacturing to a client's specifications. Its third division, Laundry Equipment Solutions, covers equipment sales, design and consulting for laundry setups, ongoing servicing and maintenance, and procurement and sourcing of laundry machinery.

Broadway Laundry serves clients across the hospitality, healthcare, education and corporate sectors, positioning its commercial laundry processing, linen supply and equipment services as a combined offering for businesses that need their linen and laundry handled, supplied or equipped rather than managed in-house.

Bronberg Storage, in Zwavelpoort, Pretoria, is a self-storage facility offering secure units for both residential and business customers. Each unit is fitted with a hinged steel door and a specialised lock, and the site operates round-the-clock security with access control. To keep units accessible during loadshedding, Bronberg Storage runs a generator between 8am and 7pm, reducing the impact of power cuts on the site's security systems.

Alongside storage units for household items, the facility offers car parking with safety measures suited to different seasons and weather conditions. Bronberg Storage provides a range of unit sizes, and its managers work with customers individually to help them choose a unit suited to the volume and type of items they need to store, from everyday household overflow to larger business stock.

Brooklyn Dens Dental Studio, on Jan Shoba Street in Brooklyn, Pretoria, is a dental practice with a particular focus on aesthetic dentistry. The practice offers a broad range of general and cosmetic treatments, including minimally invasive dentistry, composite restorations, digital scanning, CEREC CAD-CAM same-visit restorations, provisional bridges, crowns and veneers, and implant prosthesis work. It also provides clear-aligner orthodontic treatment, treatment for tooth grinding and clenching, digital panoramic X-rays, general family dentistry, tooth whitening, oral hygiene care, and in-house sterilisation of equipment.

The practice describes itself as using up-to-date diagnostic and treatment equipment across these services, aiming to combine everyday dental care with more specialised cosmetic and restorative work. Brooklyn Dens Dental Studio also sells dental-care products directly to patients, positioning itself as a single practice for both routine oral health maintenance and more advanced aesthetic dental treatment in the Brooklyn area.

BTS, with an office in Centurion Central, is part of a global consulting firm that works with organisations to turn strategy into action. The firm builds leadership capability through experiential learning and real-world application, focusing on shifting behaviour and mindset rather than only presenting strategy on paper.

Its service lines include coaching, leadership development, organisational transformation, sales performance, strategy execution, and talent insights and assessment, alongside a newer focus on AI and innovation. BTS has become a Select Services Partner in the Claude Partner Network, a role through which it helps organisations apply artificial intelligence to how people work, lead and make decisions, rather than treating AI purely as a technology project. Across its consulting work, BTS aims to make leadership and strategy development feel tailored to each client's own environment, rather than delivering a generic, identical programme to every organisation it works with.

C&D Empire Supply and Services, based in Lotus Gardens, Pretoria, is a consulting business offering services to clients across a range of industries. The company says it helps clients grow their businesses and manage the process of expansion or a new project, partnering with each client to develop a business strategy suited to their situation.

Its stated service areas are consulting, strategic planning and advising, which the company presents as complementary services for businesses at different stages of growth. C&D Empire Supply and Services describes its approach as working alongside clients to design solutions intended to be scalable as a business grows, while also helping to shape the brand experience the business presents to its own customers.

Cashbuild Olievenhoutbosch, at Olievenhout Plaza on Olifantsfontein Road in Olievenhoutbosch, Centurion, is a branch of the Cashbuild building-materials chain. The store stocks building materials, cement, timber, hardware, plumbing supplies and tools at set prices, and its staff offer advice to contractors, DIY customers and homeowners working on their own projects.

The branch accepts credit and debit cards and offers Capitec personal loans in-store, alongside the ability to buy SIM cards, airtime and data. Customers can request quotes either online or in person, and the store offers free local delivery as well as free parking for shoppers. It trades Monday to Friday from 07:00 to 18:00, Saturdays from 07:00 to 16:00, and Sundays from 08:00 to 14:00, giving contractors and homeowners access to building supplies across most of the week.

items.description:
CIM Lubricants, based in Hermanstad, Pretoria, manufactures and distributes automotive and industrial lubricants from its own blending facility. The company's product range covers automotive and heavy-duty engine oils, automotive and heavy-duty gear oils, industrial gear oils, automatic transmission fluids, heavy-duty transmission oils, hydraulic fluid, and two-stroke and outboard oils, along with greases and degreasers.

CIM Lubricants describes its lubricants as locally manufactured, and positions the business as focused on meeting defined quality and performance standards across its oil and grease ranges rather than supplying a single product line. The company supplies both automotive customers needing engine, gear and transmission oils, and industrial customers needing hydraulic fluids, greases and degreasers for machinery and equipment, blending and distributing these products from its Hermanstad base.

Clean Cut Glass & Aluminium Pty Ltd, based in Dirk Smit Industrial Park, Hennopspark, Centurion, manufactures aluminium and glass products for homes and businesses. Its product range covers windows and doors, frameless shower enclosures, shop fronts, louvres and skylights, made using what the company describes as cutting-edge manufacturing technology and durable materials.

Modern and efficient window and door designs are built to suit different home, business and building sizes, while its frameless and shower solutions are aimed at a sleeker, more contemporary look for bathrooms. Shop fronts and louvres are designed for commercial premises, and skylights are fitted to bring natural light into interior spaces. The company says it provides dedicated support from the initial concept through to final installation, and that it builds sustainability considerations into its aluminium and glass manufacturing processes.

Cleaning Warehouse Pretoria North, on Jan van Riebeeck Street in Pretoria North, sells a wide range of cleaning products under its own JiM Extreme brand. Its product line covers dishwashing liquid, an air fryer cleaner, auto dishwasher rinse aid and dishwasher salt, bathroom cleaner sold in bulk and smaller bottle sizes, a general-purpose cleaning fluid, both thick and thin bleach, a brass cleaner, and hand creams in lavender and lemon scents.

Many of these products are sold in single bottles as well as six-packs, catering to both household customers buying for home use and larger buyers stocking up on cleaning supplies in bulk. Cleaning Warehouse Pretoria North operates as part of a broader cleaning-products retailer, giving customers in Pretoria North access to its own branded detergents, bleaches and surface cleaners for kitchen, bathroom and general household cleaning.

items.description:
Co.Space Entrepreneur Village in Pretoria, near the corner of Simon Vermooten and Bronkhorstspruit roads in Derdepoort, offers more than 280 individual commercial workspaces for month-to-month rental, without longer lease commitments. The site, about a kilometre from the M4 highway, is divided into several workspace types. Offices of 15 to 30 square metres come with shopfronts and, in some units, air conditioning and a mezzanine level, along with access to printing services and business training. Warehouses and workshops of up to 50 and 60 square metres respectively include double-volume space, a dispatch and delivery service and 24-hour security, with workshops also offering three-phase electricity and prepaid water. Commercial kitchens of 24 to 60 square metres are fitted with three-phase electricity, prepaid gas and water, extraction hoods and grease traps.

Co.Space also offers hot-desking through its on-site business hub for entrepreneurs who need a workspace without a dedicated unit.
